decisions.reason: The source changes the base logo's leaf, typeface, and letter case, but does not change any color or the requirement that the platform font color match the machine font color.
Simplifying the base logo and aligning its typography with the machine does not alter the DJ-turntable-inspired visual identity.
The branding decision does not change the spout's geometry, orientation, construction, appearance reference, or beverage-quality constraints.
The base-logo changes do not affect bowl capacity, depth, form, or size reference.
The source contains no change to splash targets, guards, bowl depth, whisk positioning, or high-speed splash control.
The logo specification may inform design documentation but does not change the requirement to deliver a finalized system layout or its existing design direction.
Although the logo is placed on the base, the source does not change the platform's height, cup clearance, fit, configuration, or structural purpose.
The base-logo styling decision does not change the V1 speed priority, sourcing policy, or custom-spout fabrication decision.
The logo change does not affect serviceable fluid routing, removable panels, motor access, or other maintenance operations.
The source changes only branding details and does not affect mixing quality, foam, texture, or high-speed mixing behavior.
The base-logo specification does not change bowl removal, swapping, cleaning access, or assembly-clearance requirements.
The branding change does not affect seals, plumbing, liquid containment, or protection of the base and electronics from leaks.
